console.avis.arret_trop_long_entrainemen: "{mode}" did not stop within {delai} s: training was not started. Stop it from its tile, then click "Begin" again.
console.avis.arret_trop_long_test: "{mode}" did not stop within {delai} s: the test was not started. Stop it from its tile, then click "Begin" again.
console.avis.depart_manque_entrainement: The engine did not start the training within {delai} s: its window did not open. Read the refusal in the banner, then try again.
console.avis.depart_manque_entrainement_: The engine did not start the training within {delai} s. Read the refusal in the banner, then try again.
console.avis.depart_manque_test: The engine did not start the test within {delai} s: its window did not open. Read the refusal in the banner, then try again.
console.avis.depart_manque_verification: The engine did not start the check within {delai} s: its window did not open. Read the refusal in the banner, then try again.
console.avis.entrainement_annule:
{raison}
Training cancelled: without its window, there is nothing to learn from.
console.avis.fenetre_fermee_entrainement: The training window was closed: the session stopped (reason above).
console.avis.fenetre_fermee_test: The test window was closed: the session stopped (reason above).
console.avis.test_annule:
{raison}
Test cancelled: without its window, there is nothing to score.
console.bandeau.application.echec: The application asked "{cmd}" for "{mode}": failed after being accepted — {raison}
console.bandeau.application.set_params_r: Application: settings of "{mode}" kept (mode stopped, they apply at the next start)
console.bandeau.application.start_mode_a: Application: start of "{mode}" requested — choose its model on the control page
console.bandeau.application.start_mode_d: Application: start of "{mode}" requested again — it was already running
console.bandeau.application.stop_mode_de: Application: stop of "{mode}" requested — it was already stopped
console.bandeau.batterie_aide: Headset battery. Below 20 %, charge it before your next session: when it is flat, it refuses to open and drops out in the middle of a session.
console.bandeau.batterie_faible: ⚠ battery {pc} %: charge the headset before your next session
console.bandeau.connexion.en_cours: Connected to {nom}: the console only displays. "Disconnect" to take over again.
console.bandeau.liaison_perdue: ⚠ CONNECTION LOST with the headset for {depuis} s: nothing is decoded any more. Reconnecting (attempt {tentatives}) — {raison}. Move the headset closer and check that it is on and charged. No need to close the console.
console.bandeau.liaison_retablie: Connection restored after {coupure} s: the modes redo their rest. Channels C3 and Cz may saturate for a moment (check the signal level).
console.bandeau.paquets_perdus: ⚠ weak connection: {pc} % of samples lost (last 10 s) — move the headset closer to the PC
console.bandeau.reference_decrochee: ⚠ REFERENCE LOST (correlation between channels {correlation}): put the mastoid electrodes back on. Everything after this is unusable.
console.bandeau.sigmas_attente: signal level: waiting for the buffer…
console.bandeau.sigmas_moteur_arrete: signal level: no more readings, the engine is stopped
console.bandeau.signal_aide: Bluetooth link with the headset: {pc} % of samples lost over the last 10 seconds. Fewer bars: the headset is too far away or the link is weakening, and it will eventually drop out.
console.connexion.aide: Start your application: it appears here as soon as it announces itself. It can be an LSL application on this computer or on another computer of the network (it creates its command stream EEG_API_Unicorn_control), or a network device, such as an ESP32 on Wi-Fi. Pick it, then "Connect". Before that click, the engine listens to no application.
console.connexion.essai_en_cours: A free test is running: close its window, then connect your application.
console.connexion.identifier_aide: Asks the chosen network device to show itself (its LED blinks, for example): you check that it is yours before connecting it. An LSL application cannot do this.
console.connexion.occupe: Cannot connect: {quoi} is in progress. Wait until it is over, then connect your application.
console.connexion.pare_feu: Still nothing? Check that the application is on the same network as this computer, and that the Windows firewall allows EEG API Unicorn (or Python, if the console runs from the sources), public networks included (the computer's mobile hotspot counts as a public network).
console.connexion.vide: No application announces itself on the network. Start yours: it will appear here.
console.contact.attente_premiere_mesure: Waiting for the engine's first reading…
console.contact.conseil: Putting salt water on the electrodes is what improves the signal the most. A mastoid electrode that has come loose makes the whole session unusable, with no other sign.
console.contact.refus_attente: Waiting for the signal (≈ 2 s after the engine starts). Without a signal level reading, you would be recording blind.
console.contact.refus_reference: REFERENCE LOST (correlation between channels {correlation}): all 8 channels measure the same thing. Put the mastoid electrodes back on, or the whole recording is unusable, even if the bars look normal.
console.contact.refus_voies: {n} channel(s) in fault: {detail}. Dead (flat): electrode came loose or cable unplugged. Saturated (level > {seuil} µV): unstable contact. Add salt water, reseat the electrode and wait: this page updates by itself.
console.contact.voies_cles: Key channels: {voies} (circled in blue). Put salt water on them first. The check still covers all eight channels.
console.controle.brut: The raw signal is published as is.
console.controle.decodage_aucun: None of the application's modes is decoding yet.
console.controle.envoye_appareil_aide: A network device does not read the LSL stream: the engine sends it every decision of this mode, over UDP. The device gives a sign of life every second; if it stays silent for 5 s, the connection ends.
console.controle.etat.en_attente: waiting for you to choose a model
console.controle.fin.bye: {nom} says it is stopping: the connection is over. {arretes}
console.controle.fin.ne_repond_pas: {nom} does not answer the connection: the connection is cancelled. Check that it is running and on the same network, then connect it again. {arretes}
console.controle.fin.occupee: {nom} is already connected to the console of {hote}: the connection is cancelled. Disconnect it there, then connect it here again. {arretes}
console.controle.fin.silence: {nom} stopped sending news: the connection is over. Check that it is running and on the same network, then connect it again. {arretes}
console.controle.lu_aide: LSL says whether SOMEONE reads this stream, not who: the "What your app sees" window or a stimulus window count too. "Nobody reads it" is certain: your application receives nothing.
console.controle.marqueurs_refuses: {texte} — {n} refused: the model does not expect what the application displays
console.controle.modele_aucun: No "{mode}" model on this computer: disconnect, then train one.
console.controle.modele_demande: {nom} asks for "{mode}". Choose the model, then start decoding.
console.demarrage.appairer_aide: Opens the Windows Bluetooth settings: a new headset pairs with this PC only once ("Add device"). Then come back here and refresh the list.
console.demarrage.attente_casque: Connecting to headset "{numero}"… This takes a few seconds: it must be on and paired with this PC over Bluetooth.
console.demarrage.attente_fin_recherche: The headset search is finishing, the session opens right after…
console.demarrage.aucun_appaire: No headset is paired with this PC. Pair yours in Windows ("Pair a headset…"), then refresh the list — or type its number.
console.demarrage.casques_appaires: {n} headset(s) paired with this PC: {liste}. Turn yours on, then click OK: the console will tell you whether it responds.
console.demarrage.echec: Headset "{numero}" did not open ({raison}). Check that it is on, charged and unplugged from the cable (while charging, it refuses to open). Also check that it is paired over Bluetooth with this PC, that no other program is using it, and that the number is right. Then try again, or choose the test board (it makes a fake signal).
console.demarrage.echec_test: The test board did not open ({raison}).
console.demarrage.intro: This choice applies to the whole session: reopening the session restarts the amplifier, and channels C3 and Cz then saturate.
console.demarrage.numero_aide: The number is printed on the headset (it starts with "UN-"). The list shows the headsets paired with this PC. To check whether it is on, open it with OK.
console.demarrage.numero_manquant: Enter the headset's serial number: with several headsets in the room, it is what picks the one to open.
console.demarrage.recherche_impossible: Headset list unreadable ({raison}). Type the headset number.
console.demarrage.secteur_aide: The frequency of your wall socket's current. The console removes this hum everywhere: decoders, headset check, Raw traces. Each model you train records this filter and always decodes with it: set it BEFORE training. This choice is kept on this PC.
console.demarrage.synthetique_aide: Signal MADE UP by BrainFlow, to check that the tool runs. It measures no brain at all: never use it for a real measurement. It looks enough like EEG that you may forget that.
console.demarrage.titre: EEG_API_Unicorn — open the session on what?
console.demarrage.unicorn_aide: 8 dry electrodes at 250 Hz, over Bluetooth. Turn the headset on and check that it is paired before continuing.
console.essai.annule:
{raison}
Trial cancelled: the window did not open.
console.essai.arrete: Decoding of "{mode}" stopped: it had been started for the trial.
console.essai.attente: Its window opens in a moment. While it shows a cross, do not look at any target: the engine is measuring the background noise.
console.essai.continue: "{mode}" keeps decoding: it was already running before the trial.
console.essai.repris: "{mode}" keeps decoding: your application started or set it during the trial.
console.essai.flux_autre: "{mode}" listens to the marker stream "{ecoute}", but the trial window publishes on "{publie}": the mode would not hear it, and no target would be circled. To try it with this window, choose "{publie}" in "{champ}" (1. Set up), then try again.
console.essai.flux_tenu: "{mode}" would hear the stream "{ecoute}": the marker listener is shared, and {modes} holds it right now. The trial window publishes on "{publie}": the mode would not hear it. Stop {modes} first (its tile, or your application), then try again.
console.essai.en_cours: Free trial in progress. While the window shows a cross, do nothing: the engine settles and measures the background noise. Then look at the target of your choice (or imagine the task of your choice): the window circles what the engine decodes. Close it (Esc) to finish.
console.essai.fenetre_erreur:
Trial interrupted: its window closed on an ERROR.
{raison}
console.essai.mode_arrete_attente: "{mode}" stopped before its window opened: the trial did not take place.
console.essai.mode_arrete_fenetre: "{mode}" stopped during the trial: its window was closed.
console.essai.non_publie: "{mode}" decodes without publishing its stream: the window would have nothing to circle. Tick "published" on its tile, then try again.
console.essai.pas_demarre: The engine did not start "{mode}" within {delai} s: the window did not open. Try again.
console.essai.refus_seance: "{quoi}" is in progress: no free trial at the same time. Wait for it to end, or abort it.
console.essai.reglages_changes: The settings of "{mode}" changed during the trial: its window was showing the old targets, so it was closed. Start the trial again.
console.essai.reglages_pas_pris: The applied settings are still not in effect on "{mode}" after {delai} s: the window did not open. Try again.
console.formulaire.defauts_aide: Resets each editable field to its default value. Nothing is sent until you confirm ("Apply" or "Begin").
console.formulaire.ecran_detecte: Your main screen runs at {hz} Hz: this is where the console opens its stimulus windows. If your app shows the targets on another screen, enter that screen's frequency here.
console.grille.connecter_aide: Lists the applications of the network that want to drive the engine: those of this computer, those of other computers, and network devices (an ESP32 on Wi-Fi, for example). Pick yours: until you connect it, the engine does not listen to it.
console.langue.fenetre: a session with its stimulus window
console.formulaire.liste_indice: from {min} to {max} values, separated by commas
console.grille.barriere: GATE — pass this before anything else
console.grille.flux_aide: Opens in a separate window, which stays open during a test or a training. It reads the LSL streams on the network the way your app would: if it stays empty while a mode is decoding, the problem is in the network.
console.grille.titre_avant_tout: First — check that the headset signal is usable. Nothing is published or recorded.
console.grille.titre_sortie: Your app — connect it, then see what it actually receives, read from the network.
console.langue.bulle: Display language. The streams sent to your app (names, channels, values) do not change.
console.langue.occupe: Language unchanged: {quoi} is in progress. Change it from the home screen once it is over.
console.mode.appliquer_pendant_test: This mode is being tested: its settings stay as they are until the test ends.
console.mode.direct_aide: What continuous decoding is producing right now, if it is running.
console.mode.direct_vide: Empty while continuous decoding is stopped. Start it from the mode's tile, on the home page.
console.mode.entrainer_pas_livre: The engine cannot run the training of "{mode}" yet.
console.mode.entrainer_phrase: Creates a model from a guided session. You see its score before deciding whether to keep it.
console.mode.essayer_aide: You look at the target of your choice (or, for Motor Imagery, you imagine the task of your choice): the window circles in green what the engine decodes. It is live feedback, with no cue. The window opens straight away; while it shows a cross, do nothing: the engine settles and measures the background noise. No score is calculated, nothing is recorded. Decoding runs during the trial; if it was not running before, it stops when you close the window (Esc).
console.mode.mesurer_aide: Measures this value on you ("{mesure}"). Then "Apply" copies it into this field.
console.mode.reglage_retenu: Setting SAVED: "{mode}" is stopped. "Guided test", "Free test" and the next decoding will start with it.
console.mode.tester_pas_livre: The engine cannot run the test of "{mode}" yet.
console.mode.tester_phrase: A short session with your settings: you follow the cues and the decoding responds. You get a score, to compare with chance. Nothing is recorded.
console.moteur_mort: ⛔ THE ENGINE HAS STOPPED: nothing is acquired or published any more, the screen is frozen. Most often, the connection with the headset is lost (battery, distance, Bluetooth). Close the console, check the headset, restart. {detail}
console.moteur_mort.journal: The details are in the log file: {chemin}
console.moteur_mort.terminal: The details are in the terminal.
console.note.arret_pour_entrainement: Decoding of "{mode}" stopped for this training: the two cannot run at the same time. It will stay stopped afterwards. Restart it from its tile if your app needs it.
console.note.arret_pour_test: Decoding of "{mode}" stopped for this test: the two cannot run at the same time. It will stay stopped afterwards. Restart it from its tile if your app needs it.
console.refus.aucune_fenetre_decodage: "{mode}" has no decoding window: nothing to launch.
console.refus.aucune_fenetre_entrainemen: "{mode}" has no training window: nothing to launch.
